claims.claim: Every generated profile passes its own quality gate without template-maintenance tests
Profile output uses a schema-backed explicit asset manifest and excludes template history, tests, fixtures, incidents, and evidence
Startup and profile footprint files, bytes, and estimated tokens are measured and budgeted, with minimal strictly smallest under normalized inputs
Duplicate root and nested YAML mapping keys are rejected
Active problems, status failures, backlog lifecycle, queue state, and terminal worklog state are checked semantically
Ephemeral StateDD agent context is ignored so isolated worktrees can reach closure-grade cleanliness
